how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_015.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_attack_: Ignore weaker flame damage or resist the damage from more powerful flames.
Spew fire to burn away enemies and set fire to the land.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_dominat: Boosts the power of fire abilities by a large amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_manipul: Boosts the power of fire abilities by a decent amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_transfo: Channel the powers of fire to burn all nearby foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_wall.de: Create a wall of illusional fire to keep targets away.
Opens a Gate to Hell from which wicked flames erupt to turn your enemies to ash.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flight.descri: Propel the caster forward in the air.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.float.descrip: Decrease the caster's gravity to float.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.formhide.desc: Match your aura to the surroundings, which makes you imperceptible.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.full_recovery: Recover a living being's health and food points to the maximum as well as Absorption.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fusionist.des: Turn the world into a weapon, absorb the environment to create powerful mines and grenades.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gate.descript: Tear space asunder connecting two points in space.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.giantificatio: Grow beyond your normal size to gain increased strength and reach.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gluttony.desc: Absorb all in your path. None can win. Receive and provide skills, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.godly_craftsm: Utilize your years of experience to create masterpieces with ease and engrave your weapons for terrifying efficiency.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.godwolf_sense: Improve your senses to be able to see in the dark or even spot invisible entities nearby.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gourmand.desc: Feast on the energy of your opponents. Steal magicule with your attacks and become more powerful when killing others.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gourmet.descr: Absorb your enemies, gain new powers, and break down anything that stands in your way.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gravity_attac: Ignore weaker gravity-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gravity_domin: Boosts Gravity abilities by a large amount and allows you to fly without hindrance.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gravity_field: Weaken gravity around yourself to make movement easier or create a variously sized sphere granting previous effects while debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gravity_fligh: Manipulate gravity to allow flight, your momentum from before will be continued.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gravity_manip: Boosts Gravity abilities by a decent amount and allows you to fly without hindrance.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.great_sage.de: Improve your cognitive skills to learn and cast faster, become able to appraise targets and use analysis to copy skills and process materials to craft or clone items or equipment.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.greed.descrip: Take everything. Conquer the world and your enemies with it. Kill anyone who stands in your path while strengthening yourself or your allies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.guardian.desc: Stand as a bastion against the force of your enemies. Absorb the damage from your allies and fortify their defenses.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.haki.descript: Project your aura to cow nearby foes into submission.
